Cloudflare-native D1 sessions are already bridged Worker-to-Express by a 30-second HMAC-SHA256 assertion bound to method, exact path/query, correlation ID and Worker-hop marker; Express mounts the verification middleware globally.

A new HTTP regression test covers anonymous denial, non-admin denial and independent Cloudflare-session admin approval; it is included in npm run test:geospatial but remains unexecuted.
